items.title: Testing human ability to detect ‘deepfake’ images of human faces

judge.evidence_topic: This study aims to assess human ability to identify image deepfakes of human faces (these being uncurated output from the StyleGAN2 algorithm as trained on the FFHQ dataset) from a pool of non-deepfake images
judge.evidence_empirical: Using an online survey, participants (N = 280) were randomly allocated to one of four groups: a control group, and three assistance interventions.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico publicado em periódico revisado por pares que investiga a percepção humana de deepfakes, atendendo a todos os critérios de inclusão e exclusão. Os dados extraídos estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Warning: Humans cannot reliably detect speech deepfakes

judge.evidence_topic: Speech deepfakes are artificial voices generated by machine learning models. We presented genuine and deepfake audio to n = 529 individuals and asked them to identify the deepfakes.
judge.evidence_empirical: We presented genuine and deepfake audio to n = 529 individuals and asked them to identify the deepfakes.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos sobre a detecção de deepfakes de voz, atendendo aos critérios de inclusão. Os dados extraídos (tipo de estudo, método, amostra e achado) estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Fooled twice: People cannot detect deepfakes but think they can

judge.evidence_topic: In a pre-registered behavioral experiment ( N = 210), we show that (a) people cannot reliably detect deepfakes, and (b) neither raising awareness nor introducing financial incentives improves their detection accuracy.
judge.evidence_empirical: In a pre-registered behavioral experiment ( N = 210), we show that (a) people cannot reliably detect deepfakes
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico (experimento comportamental) sobre a percepção humana de deepfakes, alinhado ao tema. O método e o tamanho da amostra estão corretamente descritos e o achado principal é sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Deepfake detection by human crowds, machines, and machine-informed crowds

judge.evidence_topic: In two online studies with 15,016 participants, we present authentic videos and deepfakes and ask participants to identify which is which.
judge.evidence_empirical: In two online studies with 15,016 participants, we present authentic videos and deepfakes and ask participants to identify which is which.
judge.reason: O artigo trata da detecção humana de deepfakes, um tema central do pedido. É um estudo empírico com participantes humanos, sem foco em política ou saúde. O método e o achado principal estão corretamente descritos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: AI-generated images of familiar faces are indistinguishable from real photographs

judge.evidence_topic: Here, we investigated a new method for generating face images (via ChatGPT plus DALL·E) and its application to both fictional and real (in this case, celebrity) identities.
judge.evidence_empirical: Our results demonstrated that generated images of both fictional (Experiment 1) and celebrity identities (Experiment 2) could not be distinguished from real photographs. Further, providing additional real photographs for comparison during the task resulted in limited gains (Experiments 3 and 4).
judge.reason: O artigo é empírico, focado na percepção humana de imagens sintéticas, e os dados extraídos refletem fielmente o resumo fornecido.

items.title: AI-synthesized faces are indistinguishable from real faces and more trustworthy

judge.evidence_topic: Our evaluation of the photorealism of AI-synthesized faces indicates that synthesis engines have passed through the uncanny valley and are capable of creating faces that are indistinguishable-and more trustworthy-than real faces.
judge.evidence_empirical: Our evaluation of the photorealism of AI-synthesized faces indicates that synthesis engines have passed through the uncanny valley and are capable of creating faces that are indistinguishable-and more trustworthy-than real faces.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico sobre a percepção humana de rostos sintéticos, o que está alinhado com o pedido. O método e o achado principal estão corretamente descritos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: AI Hyperrealism: Why AI Faces Are Perceived as More Real Than Human Ones

judge.evidence_topic: Recent evidence shows that AI-generated faces are now indistinguishable from human faces... White AI faces are judged as human more often than actual human faces
judge.evidence_empirical: In Experiment 1 ( N = 124 adults)... In Experiment 2 ( N = 610 adults)
judge.reason: O artigo é empírico, trata da percepção humana de rostos sintéticos e os achados extraídos estão diretamente presentes no resumo.

items.title: Training human super-recognizers’ detection and discrimination of AI-generated faces

judge.evidence_topic: Here, we investigate synthetic face detection and discrimination in super-recognizers (SRs; who have exceptional face recognition skills), and typical-ability control participants.
judge.evidence_empirical: In two different experimental designs, we found that SRs (total N = 283) were better at detecting and discriminating synthetic faces than controls (total N = 381)
judge.reason: O artigo é empírico e trata do tema solicitado. O método e o achado principal estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo. Apenas o tamanho da amostra extraído está incompleto, pois omite o grupo de controle (N=381), mencionando apenas os super-reconhecedores (N=283).

items.title: Crowds Improve Human Detection of <scp>AI</scp>‐Synthesised Faces

judge.evidence_topic: Artificial intelligence can now synthesise face images which people cannot distinguish from real faces. Here, we investigated the wisdom of the (outer) crowd (averaging individuals' responses to the same trial) and inner crowd (averaging the same individual's responses to the same trial after completing the test twice) as routes to increased performance.
judge.evidence_empirical: In Experiment 1, participants viewed synthetic and real faces, and rated whether they thought each face was synthetic or real using a 1–7 scale. Each participant completed the task twice. In Experiment 2, participants judged each face only once, providing a binary ‘synthetic/real’ response
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos sobre a detecção de rostos sintéticos, atendendo aos critérios. O método descrito no resumo condiz com o que foi extraído. O achado principal é sustentado pelo texto do resumo.

items.title: Providing detection strategies to improve human detection of deepfakes: An experimental study

judge.evidence_topic: In this preregistered online experiment, participants (N = 454, Mage = 37.19, SDage = 13.25, males = 57.5%) categorize a series of 20 videos as either real or deepfake.
judge.evidence_empirical: In this preregistered online experiment, participants (N = 454, Mage = 37.19, SDage = 13.25, males = 57.5%) categorize a series of 20 videos as either real or deepfake.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos sobre a detecção de deepfakes, sem focar em algoritmos, política ou saúde. Os dados extraídos refletem fielmente o método e os resultados apresentados no resumo.

items.title: Deepfake detection with and without content warnings

judge.evidence_topic: We conduct an experiment to measure people's alertness to and ability to detect a high-quality deepfake among a set of videos.
judge.evidence_empirical: We conduct an experiment to measure people's alertness to and ability to detect a high-quality deepfake among a set of videos.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico experimental que investiga a percepção humana de deepfakes, alinhando-se ao tema. O método descrito no resumo condiz com o informado. O achado principal reflete exatamente os dados apresentados no resumo. O tamanho da amostra não consta no resumo fornecido.

items.title: Effects of Browsing Conditions and Visual Alert Design on Human Susceptibility to Deepfakes

judge.evidence_topic: The increasing reach of deepfakes raises practical questions about people’s ability to detect false videos online. ... found in a series of online experiments that all conditions lowered detection relative to baseline
judge.evidence_empirical: found in a series of online experiments that all conditions lowered detection relative to baseline
judge.reason: O artigo aborda a detecção humana de deepfakes, é um estudo empírico baseado em experimentos online e o resumo não menciona o tamanho da amostra, validando o dado extraído. O achado principal é sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Assessing the perceived credibility of deepfakes: The impact of system-generated cues and video characteristics

judge.evidence_topic: This article conducted two randomized controlled 2 × 2 × 2 experiments ( N = 518) to explore the influence of heuristic cues (including the number of followers, popularity, and description as variables) generated by the system and video characteristics (including definition, duration, and editing as variables).
judge.evidence_empirical: This article conducted two randomized controlled 2 × 2 × 2 experiments ( N = 518)
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos que investiga a percepção de credibilidade de deepfakes, alinhando-se perfeitamente ao pedido. Os dados extraídos (tipo de estudo, método, amostra e achado) estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Deciphering authenticity in the age of AI: how AI-generated disinformation images and AI detection tools influence judgements of authenticity

judge.evidence_topic: AI-generated images, which have been used as part of political disinformation campaigns.
judge.evidence_empirical: In this study, 292 UK-based participants were presented with both AI-generated and non-AI-generated disinformation images
judge.reason: O artigo é excluído por tratar de 'disinformation images' no contexto de 'political disinformation campaigns', o que se enquadra na restrição de excluir estudos centrados em propaganda política.

items.title: Conspiracy thinking and social media use are associated with ability to detect deepfakes

judge.evidence_topic: The aim of the current study was to investigate the predictors of human performance at recognizing deepfake videos.
judge.evidence_empirical: The aim of the current study was to investigate the predictors of human performance at recognizing deepfake videos. Our findings show that humans perform better at recognizing deepfake videos of familiar persons compared to deepfakes of unfamiliar persons.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos sobre a detecção de deepfakes, e os achados extraídos correspondem exatamente ao que é relatado no resumo.

items.title: Detecting Deepfakes Through Emotion?: Facial Expression and Emotional Contagion as Dual Indicators of Deepfake Credibility

judge.evidence_topic: This study examines the differences in emotional expressions between face‐swap deepfake videos featuring real human subjects and their authentic counterparts and investigates how these discrepancies influence viewers' emotional reactions and perceptions of video credibility.
judge.evidence_empirical: Next, guided by emotional contagion and emotion‐as‐information frameworks, we conducted an audience response analysis to assess how displayed emotions in the two types of videos transfer to viewers' emotional experiences and their subsequent assessments of the videos.
judge.reason: O artigo é empírico, focado na percepção humana de deepfakes, e o achado principal reflete exatamente o que está descrito no resumo.

items.title: Deepfake smiles matter less—the psychological and neural impact of presumed AI-generated faces

judge.evidence_topic: Here we investigate the impact of the belief that depicted persons are real or deepfakes on psychological and neural measures of human face perception.
judge.evidence_empirical: Using EEG, we tracked participants’ (N = 30) brain responses to real faces showing positive, neutral, and negative expressions, after being informed that they are either real or fake.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico publicado em periódico (Scientific Reports) que investiga a percepção humana de rostos sintéticos (deepfakes) usando EEG e medidas psicológicas, atendendo a todos os critérios do pedido. O achado principal está claramente sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: UNMASKING MEDIA ILLUSION: ANALYTICAL SURVEY OF DEEPFAKE VIDEO DETECTION AND EMOTIONAL INSIGHTS

judge.evidence_topic: This exploratory study investigates the psychological and demographic factors influencing the ability to detect deepfake videos... The survey incorporated deepfake and genuine videos to assess participants' identification accuracy and confidence levels.
judge.evidence_empirical: A comprehensive survey administered to 71 participants from two Midwestern universities collected data on psychological and cognitive factors, digital literacy levels, demographics, and deepfake detection abilities.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico (survey) com participantes humanos sobre a detecção de deepfakes, alinhando-se ao tema e aos critérios de exclusão. O método e o achado extraídos estão corretamente fundamentados no resumo.

items.title: The Relationship of Digital Literacy, Exposure to AI-Generated Deepfake Videos, and the Ability to Identify Deepfakes in Generation X Hubungan Literasi Digital, Paparan Video Deepfake yang Dihasilkan AI, dan Kemampuan untuk Mengidentifikasi Deepfake pada Generasi X

judge.evidence_topic: Studi ini mengeksplorasi hubungan literasi digital, paparan video deepfake yang dihasilkan AI, dan kemampuan untuk mengidentifikasi deepfake oleh Generasi X
judge.evidence_empirical: Melalui survei yang melibatkan 199 responden yang diambil dari total populasi 42 juta pengguna internet Generasi X di Indonesia, studi ini menggunakan metode sampling acak.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico (survey) que investiga a capacidade de humanos (Geração X) identificarem deepfakes, o que está alinhado com o tema e as restrições do pedido. O achado principal está diretamente sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Comparing AI and humans’ ability to recognize AI-generated images

judge.evidence_topic: This study compares humans’ ability to recognize AI-generated images to that of AI models designed to detect these images. The study prompted humans and machines to classify 80 images of four categories (animal, architecture, landscape, and vehicle) as real or generated.
judge.evidence_empirical: The study prompted humans and machines to classify 80 images of four categories (animal, architecture, landscape, and vehicle) as real or generated.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico que envolve participantes humanos na classificação de imagens sintéticas, atendendo aos critérios do pedido. O método descrito no resumo coincide com os dados extraídos, e o achado principal é sustentado pelas evidências apresentadas no texto do resumo.

items.title: Effect of AI Performance, Risk Perception, and Trust on Human Dependence in Deepfake Detection AI System

judge.evidence_topic: This study examines the role of AI performance in influencing human trust and decision making in synthetic data identification.
judge.evidence_empirical: Through an online human subject experiment involving 400 participants, we examined how varying AI performance impacts human trust and dependence on AI in deepfake detection.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos sobre a percepção e dependência de sistemas de detecção de deepfakes, atendendo aos critérios. O achado principal é sustentado diretamente pelo resumo.

items.title: Development and Validation of the Perceived Deepfake Trustworthiness Questionnaire (PDTQ) in Three Languages

judge.evidence_topic: In the present study, we developed and validated the Perceived Deepfake Trustworthiness Questionnaire (PDTQ) in English, Italian, and Slovene. This was done in three phases... a better understanding of how individuals perceive such content and the variables related to the perceived trustworthiness of deepfakes is needed.
judge.evidence_empirical: Lastly, we evaluated the psychometric characteristics via a cross-sectional study in three languages (N = 733).
judge.reason: O artigo é empírico, focado na percepção humana de deepfakes, e o método e achados descritos estão alinhados com o resumo.

items.title: Assessing the visual appeal of real/AI-generated food images

judge.evidence_topic: A study designed to investigate the ability of individuals to differentiate between AI-generated and authentic food images
judge.evidence_empirical: Two online experiments were conducted with real and AI-generated food images
judge.reason: O artigo aborda a percepção humana de imagens sintéticas, enquadrando-se no tema. O estudo é empírico, o método está corretamente descrito e o achado principal é sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: De lo real a lo ficticio: evaluación de la credibilidad de noticias difundidas por humanos y por avatares creados con inteligencia artificial

judge.evidence_topic: El presente estudio experimental aborda el impacto del tipo de emisor de información en la percepción de credibilidad de las noticias tecnológicas.
judge.evidence_empirical: La investigación involucró a 150 estudiantes universitarios, quienes, mediante un diseño entre sujetos 3 x 1, observaron un video sobre un innovador invento médico.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico que avalia a percepção de credibilidade de avatares de IA, o que se enquadra no tema. O uso de um invento médico como tema da notícia não caracteriza o artigo como um estudo sobre saúde, mas sim como um estudo de comunicação e percepção. Os dados extraídos estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.
